name: The Xenobiologist
description: Hey there, I'm Dr. Snow, the Xenobiologist of this vessel. Usually I assist in implementing new technologies from alien life or dig up any remnants of past civilizations. You'd be surprised how much history is infused into these parts of space.

quests.name: Taint Seed Autopsy
quests.description: Yea, i think you messed up a bit and the tendrils spread, didn't they? You'd probably want to find the source of that purple gas. As long as it's lingering in the atmosphere, the seeds just seem to grow back rather quickly.

quests.name: Giant Taint Seed Autopsy
quests.description: This cocoon-shaped thing appears to infect and cover its surroundings in a web of purple tendrils that resemble itself. Might prove useful later, but i don't blame you for slaughtering it. Looks really parasitic.

tasks.longDescription: You have killed the following mob:

quests.name: Taintacle Autopsy
quests.description: A more defense-oriented growth of the purple mass. From the Autopsy i have determined that it's mostly an amalgamation of regular taint fibers. unusually muscly ones, so that explains the movement. They also appear to have some sort of sensory organ at the tip, likely to be the reason as to why it can "alert" the tendrils around it to attack you.

quests.name: Taint Swarm Autopsy
quests.description: These insects appear from Taint geysers and seem to atack only in swarms. Individually, they are very easy to kill though, with even a sword being sharp enough to wipe them out in swathes. A few precise blows at where the center of the swarm should be usually suffices to fend them off.

tasks.longDescription: You have killed the following mob:

quests.name: The Source
quests.description: So I think I've got this all wrong. I've reported back to Dr. Hanai and they were adamant that this was not, in fact, what they were picking up, rather there is apparently a concentration of refined metal at these locations. We're thinking these might be remnants of an advanced civilization. Yes, this means you'll have to trek through the purple stuff. If there's still salvageable technology to be found, we have to try.

quests.name: Zombie Villager Autopsy
quests.description: This zombie sports a bigger forehead and nose than the others, meaning that it must have been a villager when it was still alive. The brain doesn't show too much atrophy from what i can tell, so there may be a way to cure them. Right now, there's no good way of gauging the financial situation of this fallen civilization, but we could deduce some things from what these guys can trade.

tasks.longDescription: You have killed the following mob:

quests.name: The Pollution
quests.description: So let me get this straight. A weird Infestation comes out of nowhere and you don't even question why it chose to attack you specifically? Turns out, some of your thaumaturgic devices pollute the Atmosphere with Flux, those violet puffs of smoke you can occasionally see rising from your crucibles and essentia Smelters. This stuff, fascinatingly, is the only thing this Taint needs for sustenance, happily spreading its tendrils through biomass, soil, and even solid rock if there's enough Flux in the air. So the more you pollute, well, you know.

quests.name: Taint Geyser Autopsy
quests.description: Gah! I know i asked for video footage, but did you have to split that thing open like that? I had to throw up twice to extract any information from the video. So anyway, these things grow on infected trees and tree stumps and seem to contain a biofactory that spits out insect-like creatures to defend the taint. It is also seemingly capable of slowly producing more of the gas that keep the infestation growing, so destroy them on sight. just be a bit more discrete next time, will ya?

quests.name: The Undead
quests.description: Ah, Zombies and Skelletons, just like back home. You should be experienced with fighting these off, right? Only notable thing here is that they seem to only manifest in absolute darkness here, meaning that flatter areas are unusually safe. A rare blessing for us when basically everything else different was also to our detriment, like the hard wood preventing you from making planks without a saw, or the brittle stone, unfit for making tools and collapsing your mines.

quests.name: Cyberzombie Autopsy
quests.description: This zombie seems to have undergone several surgeries during its lifetime to augment its body with cybernetics. This is promising, as it shows that such advanced technology can exist down there, but the parts show severe decomposition, as is to be expected from a zombie. Maybe you can salvage some of the parts nonetheless. Maybe we can reverse-engineer, or at least use them ourselves.

tasks.longDescription: You have killed the following mob:

quests.name: The Disease
quests.description: You appear to have stumbled upon some new kind of lifeform that seems to be the source of the strange signatures we've been detecting. It looks like some mix between a slime mold and something straight out of a hentai. It also appears to be rather parasitic in nature, there's no way it's practicing photosynthesis with that bright purple hue.

quests.name: Tainted Rock
quests.description: Apparently, Taint even spreads its ugly fibers through solid rock. Though unlike most things it produces, this one might actually prove beneficial to us: if you either kill off the taint seeds or harvest the rock using silk touch and place it outside of the seeds' range, it will transform into porous stone that can be broken like normal (though fortune will be beneficial), producing all kinds of useful resources.

tasks.longDescription: You have broken the following block:

quests.name: Tainted Crawler Autopsy
quests.description: These little Creepy-crawlies are especially connected to the taint fibers. So connected, in fact, that they either have them growing out of them or are dragging them away from the source to spread. Results have been inconclusive so far.
